plan.title: Paired treatment vs control DE + pathways
plan.analytical_narrative: 5 subjects each contribute a control and a treated blood sample (10 samples, 12000 genes, STAR/featureCounts raw counts). To answer 'which genes respond to treatment within each subject', the subject must be a blocking term in the design: ~ subject + condition, tested with the DESeq2 Wald test on raw integer counts (no length correction, no tximport, no pre-normalization), with apeglm shrinkage for the reported fold change, BH at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering, and a robustness cross-check with edgeR quasi-likelihood. Significant genes feed an over-representation analysis against the WikiPathways human gene sets (the human pathway resource available here), with the tested genes as the universe. A GC/length bias diagnostic is included because cqn/EDASeq are absent. Small-cohort caveats: n=5 per group, Cook's-distance outlier genes will be NA and are reported separately; no co-expression or network inference is planned (under R-0140@0f16, <15 samples).
